sections.title: Sound of ze
paragraphs: The letter name is (зэ) /zɛ/. Its main sound appears in (зима) /zʲɪˈma/, which means winter. This letter has four sounds.

sections.title: How to say ze
paragraphs: Touch the teeth ridge with your tongue tip and push air through the narrow gap. Keep your voice on so your throat vibrates. For the second sound, lift the middle of your tongue toward the hard roof. For the third sound, keep the first tongue shape, but turn your voice off completely. For the fourth sound, turn your voice off while lifting your tongue. Put your hand on your throat to feel the voice turn on and off.

sections.title: Spelling of ze
paragraphs: Before hard vowels and voiced consonants, the letter makes a regular sound, as in (зуб) /zup/. Before soft vowels and the soft sign, it becomes palatalized, as in (зелень) /ˈzʲe.lʲɪnʲ/. At the end of a word, it loses its voice, as in (глаз) /ɡlas/. At the end of a word with a soft sign, it loses its voice while staying soft, as in (мазь) /masʲ/.

sections.title: Comparing ze to English
paragraphs: Do not confuse the soft sound with English z in zoo. The soft sound lifts the tongue, making it closer to the sound in yield. When this letter appears at the end of a word, do not keep your voice on. Turn your voice off so the ending sounds like s in bus, not z in buzz.
